climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A cool-climate region between Burgundy and Switzerland, with distinctive wines. Its best-known style is vin jaune, made from Savagnin under a flor-like yeast, alongside Poulsard, Trousseau and Chardonnay, vin de paille, Crémant du Jura and Macvin.
